mapper.select: SELECT device_id, AVG(voltage) as avgVoltage, AVG(current_val) as avgCurrent, AVG(power) as avgPower, AVG(temperature) as avgTemperature FROM device_data WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND collect_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY device_id

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(collect_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') as period,
DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(collect_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), INTERVAL FLOOR(MINUTE(collect_time)/5)*5 MINUTE) as period,
DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(collect_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), INTERVAL IF(MINUTE(collect_time)<30,0,30) MINUTE) as period,
AVG(voltage) as voltage, AVG(current_val) as currentVal, AVG(power) as power, AVG(temperature) as temperature, AVG(power_factor) as powerFactor FROM device_data WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND collect_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

SELECT d.device_id AS deviceId, d.voltage, d.current_val AS currentVal, d.power, d.temperature, d.power_factor AS powerFactor, d.frequency, d.energy_consumption AS energyConsumption, d.energy_cost AS energyCost, DATE_FORMAT(d.collect_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS collectTime, d.humidity FROM device_data d INNER JOIN ( SELECT device_id, MAX(collect_time) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY device_id ) latest ON d.device_id = latest.device_id AND d.collect_time = latest.max_time
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM device_data WHERE collect_time < NOW() - INTERVAL #{days} DAY
